sources.title: Point-mass pendulum and small-angle frequency
sources.scope: Ordinary real point-mass mechanics; g>0, l>0, m>0; angle in radians; unforced and undamped. Frequency and period use the small-angle linear model.

sources.title: Three active right-handed axis rotations
sources.scope: Ordinary real SO(3), active rotations of column vectors in a right-handed frame. Degree input is converted to radians before sine and cosine.

sources.title: Zeta–gamma Mellin integral
sources.scope: Ordinary complex s with Re(s)>1; real integration variable t>0 and t^(s-1)=exp((s-1)*log(t)).
